import json, os, shutil

os.environ.setdefault("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM", "false")

ADAPTER_ID = "dominguesm/xlm-roberta-base-lora-language-detection"

CACHE = "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base"
MERGED = "/app/merged_model"
WORK = "/app/.build/adapter_local"
RESULTS = "/app/detection_results.json"
NUM_LABELS = 20

TEXTS = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Hola, \u00bfc\u00f3mo est\u00e1s hoy?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "Ciao, come stai oggi?",
    "Ol\u00e1, como voc\u00ea est\u00e1?",
    "\u041f\u0440\u0438\u0432\u0435\u0442, \u043a\u0430\u043a \u0434\u0435\u043b\u0430?",

    "\u4f60\u597d\uff0c\u4f60\u597d\u304b\uff1f",
    "\u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627\u060c \u0643\u064a\u0641 \u062d\u0627\u0644\u0643\u061f",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]

    print(*a, flush=True)

    os.makedirs(HF_CACHE, exist_ok=True)

    log("adapter snapshot:", adapter_repo)
    with open(os.path.join(adapter_repo, "adapter_config.json")) as fh:
        acfg = json.load(fh)
    log("adapter_config:", json.dumps(acfg, sort_keys=True))

    if os.path.exists(label_path):
        with open(label_path) as fh:
            lcfg = json.load(fh)
        id2label = {int(k): v for k, v in lcfg["id2label"].items()}
        label2id = {v: k for k, v in id2label.items()}
    else:
        id2label = {i: "LABEL_%d" % i for i in range(NUM_LABELS)}
        label2id = {v: k for k, v in id2label.items()}
    assert len(id2label) == NUM_LABELS, "expected %d labels, got %d" % (NUM_LABELS, len(id2label))
    log("id2label loaded from adapter metadata:", json.dumps({str(k): v for k, v in sorted(id2label.items())}))

    log("== 2. tokenizer ==")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE_ID, cache_dir=HF_CACHE)
    log("tokenizer:", type(tokenizer).__name__, "vocab", len(tokenizer))

    log("== 3. base model with %d classes ==" % NUM_LABELS)
    base = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        BASE_ID, num_labels=NUM_LABELS, id2label=id2label, label2id=label2id, cache_dir=HF_CACHE
    )
    log("classifier shape:", base.classifier.in_features, "->", base.classifier.out_features)
    assert base.classifier.out_features == NUM_LABELS

    log("== 4. save base + tokenizer to %s ==" % CACHE)
    base.save_pretrained(CACHE, safe_serialization=True)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(CACHE)
    log("saved:", sorted(os.listdir(CACHE)))

    log("== 5. normalise adapter weights to safetensors ==")
    if os.path.isdir(WORK):
        shutil.rmtree(WORK)
    os.makedirs(WORK)
    shutil.copy(os.path.join(adapter_repo, "adapter_config.json"), os.path.join(WORK, "adapter_config.json"))
    src_st = os.path.join(adapter_repo, "adapter_model.safetensors")
    src_bin = os.path.join(adapter_repo, "adapter_model.bin")
    if os.path.exists(src_st):
        sd = load_file(src_st)
        log("source: adapter_model.safetensors")
    else:
        sd = torch.load(src_bin, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        log("source: adapter_model.bin (torch.load)")
    sd = {k: v.contiguous().clone() for k, v in sd.items() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)}
    log("adapter tensors:", len(sd))
    save_file(sd, os.path.join(WORK, "adapter_model.safetensors"))

    lora_keys = [k for k in sd if "lora_A" in k or "lora_B" in k]
    log("lora tensor count:", len(lora_keys))
    for k in sorted(lora_keys)[:4]:
        log("   ", k, tuple(sd[k].shape))

    hw_key = next((k for k in sd if k.endswith("classifier.modules_to_save.default.weight")), None)
    hb_key = next((k for k in sd if k.endswith("classifier.modules_to_save.default.bias")), None)
    if hw_key is None:
        hw_key = next((k for k in sd if k.endswith("classifier.weight")), None)
        hb_key = next((k for k in sd if k.endswith("classifier.bias")), None)
    if hw_key is None:
        raise SystemExit("FATAL: adapter checkpoint contains no classifier head")
    log("head weight key:", hw_key, tuple(sd[hw_key].shape))
    log("head bias key:", hb_key, tuple(sd[hb_key].shape) if hb_key else None)
    assert tuple(sd[hw_key].shape)[0] == NUM_LABELS, "adapter head is not %d-way: %s" % (NUM_LABELS, tuple(sd[hw_key].shape))

    log("== 6. reload base from cache and apply LoRA adapter ==")
    base = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(CACHE)
    base.eval()
    q_before = {i: base.roberta.encoder.layer[i].attention.self.query.weight.detach().clone() for i in (0, 6, 11)}
    peft_model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, WORK)
    log("peft model loaded:", type(peft_model).__name__)
    unwrapped = peft_model.base_model.model
    head_now = unwrapped.classifier.modules_to_save["default"].original.weight if hasattr(unwrapped.classifier, "modules_to_save") else unwrapped.classifier.weight
    log("head diff right after from_pretrained: %.3e" % (head_now.detach().float() - sd[hw_key].float()).abs().max().item())

    log("== 7. merge and unload ==")
    merged = peft_model.merge_and_unload()
    merged.eval()
    assert not any("lora" in n for n, _ in merged.named_modules()), "lora modules survived the merge"
    log("lora modules remaining: 0")

    for i, w in q_before.items():
        d = (merged.roberta.encoder.layer[i].attention.self.query.weight.detach() - w).abs().max().item()
        log("   layer %2d query delta: %.6e" % (i, d))
        assert d > 1e-5, "LoRA delta did not land in layer %d" % i

    head_diff = (merged.classifier.weight.detach().float() - sd[hw_key].float()).abs().max().item()
    log("classifier head max|diff| vs adapter: %.3e" % head_diff)
    if head_diff > 1e-6:
        log("!! head was NOT restored by PEFT; copying the adapter's trained head in")
        with torch.no_grad():
            merged.classifier.weight.copy_(sd[hw_key].float())
            if hb_key is not None:
                merged.classifier.bias.copy_(sd[hb_key].float())
        head_diff = (merged.classifier.weight.detach().float() - sd[hw_key].float()).abs().max().item()
        log("   head max|diff| after repair: %.3e" % head_diff)
        assert head_diff <= 1e-6, "head repair failed"

    merged.config.num_labels = NUM_LABELS
    merged.config.id2label = id2label
    merged.config.label2id = label2id

    log("== 8. save merged model + tokenizer to %s ==" % MERGED)
    os.makedirs(MERGED, exist_ok=True)
    merged.save_pretrained(MERGED, safe_serialization=True)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(MERGED)
    log("saved:", sorted(os.listdir(MERGED)))

    log("== 9. reload merged model from disk and predict ==")
    model = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MERGED)
    model.eval()
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MERGED)
    enc = tok(TEXTS, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=512, return_tensors="pt")
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(**enc).logits
    log("logits shape:", tuple(logits.shape))
    probs = torch.softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
    conf, pred = probs.max(dim=-1)

    results = []
    for i, text in enumerate(TEXTS):
        pid = int(pred[i].item())
        c = float(conf[i].item())
        top2 = torch.topk(probs[i], 2)
        log("  sample %2d pred=%2d conf=%.4f  margin=%.4f  label=%s  | %s"
            % (i + 1, pid, c, float(top2.values[0] - top2.values[1]), id2label.get(pid, "?"), text))
        results.append({"text": text, "predicted_class_id": pid, "confidence": round(c, 6)})

    with open(RESULTS, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(results, fh, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        fh.write("\n")
    log("wrote", RESULTS)

    distinct = len({r["predicted_class_id"] for r in results})
    log("distinct predicted ids: %d of %d (10 expected for 10 distinct languages)" % (distinct, len(results)))
    log("DONE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
